blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Jema Galanza lamented Creamline’s miscues, especially in the fifth set, as the Cool Smashers dropped their highly anticipated match against Choco Mucho in the 2026 PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series. Creamline absorbed its second straight loss, 23-25, 25-13, 25-23, 22-25, 15-13, after giving up 27 free points to Choco Mucho from errors on Thursday at Smart Araneta Coliseum. “We committed a lot of errors and gave away so many points. But that’s how it is sometimes. Nobody’s perfect, and as a team, we also made mistakes during crucial moments,” said Galanza in Filipino after tallying 16 points, 13 […]...
